intended_object: An intermediate K-algebra map A ⊗_k K → Γ(X_K, O), where A is the library's chosen greatest finite étale k-subalgebra of Γ(X, O) (the coordinate algebra of π₀(X)). The map is the inclusion A ⊆ Γ(X) tensored with K, followed by the isomorphism Γ(X) ⊗_k K ≅ Γ(X_K). Inferred from the docstring and from the module's proof that π₀ commutes with field extension.
